column1: # Game profile of Mina the Hollower (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.0.5 = v1). Plays on the Mac
# Yacht Club Games' own engine, NVN, SDK 21.4.3. Every RomFS file is a YCD container (*.yc); the shaders are control sections and code areas in shaders.pak.yc (dm/gfx/tools/ycd.py)
# The NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps its memory itself.
# Its regions: malloc's StandardAllocator (16 GB asked, which the host caps), two TLSF heaps of 4 GB each that the rewriter cuts to 1 GB and 256 MB (patches.py), a 64 MB one and
# thirteen 16 MB pools. 1.51 GB mapped from boot into the first minute of play (README.md, Memory)
# the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource
# malloc's StandardAllocator over 16 GB gets 2.5 GB (hle_svc.c, the host's StandardAllocator cap): the regions made after it take 1.55 GB (the 1 GB and 256 MB heaps, 64 MB, thirteen
# 16 MB pools at 18 MB spacing), more than the 256 MB the default leaves; 4.375 GB less the 62 MB node area, those and 256 MB for later regions, in 32 MB steps. It maps 1.28 GB
